sentences.text: Radar ties directly into the Navigation Rules.
If your boat has radar, Rule seven requires you to use it properly, including long-range scanning for early warning.
A target seen only on radar is not in sight, so in fog Rule nineteen applies, and you avoid turning to port for a target forward of the beam.
Make your own boat a better target with a radar reflector mounted as high as practical.
And practice with radar on clear days, comparing the screen with what you see, so you can trust your interpretation when the fog rolls in.
